authority.freeze_rule: Placement, visibility and transport semantics are frozen before gateway-local exact admission. Baseline or proposed-method outcomes are not a valid reason to change them.

global_invariants: A policy may use only observations that have lawfully arrived at its declared placement.
Gateway queue, send log and gateway receipt are owner-local gateway state, not center-visible facts.
Future service transitions, future opportunity identities and evaluator world IDs are never query payloads.
If a center query requires a communication path, center-issued send/control commands require an explicit outbound control path and arrival time.
Gateway receipt and final center delivery acknowledgement remain distinct events.
Owner-local state projection does not inherit remote-query delay or communication cost.
The frozen v0.7 generator is not rewritten by this downstream evaluation coordinate.

control_transport.claim_boundary: This models gateway-local autonomy, not instantaneous remote control.

visible_when_released_or_executed: gateway receipt after the declared receipt event
local terrestrial and fallback resource ledger
final center acknowledgement or timeout after it arrives

receipt_summary.payload: gateway receipts that have actually occurred by the observation time

required_missing_contracts: gateway-to-center telemetry trigger, payload, required path and arrival delay
center-to-gateway send/control command transport and arrival time
command timeout, deduplication and acknowledgement semantics
resource sharing between data, telemetry, query and control traffic
CENTER_REMOTE_CONTROL.admission_rule: No center-placement exact, no-query or paid-evidence classification may run until every missing transport contract is explicit and audited.
CENTER_REMOTE_CONTROL.allowed_current_role: documented simulator gap and future placement control

downstream_projection.gateway_local_structure_rule: Deduplicate frozen v0.7 variants by base_structure_id + feedback_profile + fallback_budget_mode; remote-query timing is inactive at gateway placement.

next_gates: gateway-local passive feedback versus normal send-as-probe competition
